questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, select the one that gives its correct order.**

A. He told his friends that his difficulties were a sign of God’s confidence in him.

B. A businessman remained cheerful even though he suffered one catastrophe after another.

C. Therefore, when he was serving in the armed forces too, his senior officer had chosen him for dangerous missions because he knew he could be trusted.

D. First, his son had a serious accident and then he had huge losses in his business, but he was not perturbed.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **BDAC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On reading the sentences, we can comprehend that the passage is all about Businessman and his life story.
 
• The first sentence will be sentence B as it tells us about the businessman.
 
• The second sentence will be sentence D as it tells us about the life of a businessman what has happened in his life.
 
• The third sentence will be sentence A as it tells us that the businessman about his life to his friends and they told him to have faith in God.
 
• The fourth sentence will be sentence C as it is the only sentence Left.

**So the correct passage is**- *A businessman remained cheerful even though he suffered one catastrophe after another. First, his son had a serious accident and then he had huge losses in his business, but he was not perturbed. He told his friends that his difficulties were a sign of God’s confidence in him. Therefore, when he was serving in the armed forces too, his senior officer had chosen him for dangerous missions because he knew he could be trusted.*

questions.question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

Each players must play according to his full potential and not think only about winning.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is-** "Each players"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of 'players' is incorrect instead of it use 'player'
 
• According to grammar, whenever we have 'each, every, everyone as a determiner then we need to use a singular noun.
 
• The quantifiers each and every are a kind of determiner. They have similar but not always identical meanings. We always use them with a singular countable noun.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Each artist sees things differently.
 
 

**Hence, the correct sentence is-** *Each** player** must play according to his full potential and not think only about winning.*
